fields.description: Velora 2 is a three- and four-bedroom townhouse release in The Valley’s second phase. Contemporary homes sit within a gated neighbourhood shaped by green spaces, walking routes and outdoor recreation. This release has its own Ravine, Serene and Nash layouts, separate from the earlier Velora collection.

overview: The brochure describes light-filled interiors, a neutral palette and shared leisure facilities. Adult and children’s pools sit alongside a fitness centre, play areas and places for outdoor dining. The larger Valley masterplan includes further parks and cycling routes; their delivery and access should be checked separately from the townhouse purchase.

Velora 2’s own cluster map identifies a community centre, community garden, flexible lawn and games-and-fitness pod. Sports courts and children’s spaces are distributed around the neighbourhood. These local features help distinguish a plot’s immediate surroundings from the wider community amenities.
research.locationNote: Velora 2 is part of The Valley along the Dubai–Al Ain Road corridor. Compare the exact home’s position, entrance route and connection to green spaces; the master-community address alone does not establish walking distance or commute time.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 2.93m. The launch fact sheet lists three-bedroom homes from AED 2.93m and four-bedroom homes from AED 3.37m. These figures are historical starting references rather than live inventory quotations.
research.paymentNote: The October 2024 launch schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% at completion. It includes construction-linked instalments. Current outstanding amounts, revised dates and resale terms need confirmation for the chosen home.
research.handoverNote: The payment sheet estimates July 2028; Property Finder also gives July 2028. This remains a forecast subject to contractual terms and a current developer update.

facts.label: Launch unit mix
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 312 homes, split equally between 156 three-bedroom and 156 four-bedroom townhouses. This is the launch mix, not availability.

facts.label: Arrangement
facts.value: Plans show two-level homes in four-unit blocks, with three bedrooms in the middle and four bedrooms at the ends. Maid’s rooms, carports and terraces are included in the drawings.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Totals include suite, garage and balcony/terrace space. Suite areas are approximately 1,981.85–1,982.28 sq ft for three bedrooms and 2,218.66–2,221.45 sq ft for four; land area is separate.

unresolved: The fact sheet’s prose inconsistently calls all homes four-bedroom semi-detached units; its mix table and official plans clearly show three/four-bedroom homes in four-unit blocks.
Commercial and cluster documents are Emaar-branded broker-hosted copies. Current payment obligations, plot measurements, service charges and final specifications require developer confirmation.

No live inventory or independently verified current construction percentage is asserted. Wider-community facilities may have separate delivery dates, and existing site photography remains illustrative.
